info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API provides a seamless way for users to cancel booked airline flights. This endpoint facilitates the cancellation process by allowing consumers, such as travel agencies and airlines, to manage flight reservations effectively. Users can specify the flight details and receive confirmation of the cancellation. This API is essential for enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency within the travel industry.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an existing flight reservation. Make sure to provide the necessary flight details to successfully process the cancellation.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a flight. This should contain the necessary details for identifying the flight to be cancelled, along with any other relevant information as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request to cancel flight processed successfully.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for cancelling a flight operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number for the cancellation operation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the operation of canceling a flight.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details for tracking the audit of the flight cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
